name: FNaF - Count The Ways
source:
Take the POV of Millie, a goth girl who learns to be careful what you wish for as she finds herself trapped in an animatronic stomach cavity, in this Five Nights at Freddy's fan game visual novel based of the book 'Count The Ways'. This is simply a fangame made out of love for the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise, and in no way claims to be a legitimate game in the franchise.

[From [url=https://sash-beans.itch.io/count]Itch.io[/url]]
